premises.text: Users suffer when app state does not follow them across phones, tablets, and web
premises.evidence_span: Have you ever beat that frustrating level of Angry Birds on your phone, only to find that you can't unlock the next level on your tablet?

premises.text: Nimbus Base is a mobile/web backend that stores data in users' personal clouds and syncs with a few lines of code
premises.evidence_span: all of this is done with a few lines of code from developers

premises.text: Offline-local then sync architecture plus user-owned deletion give continuity and data control
premises.evidence_span: It gives you data continuity across devices and lets you have complete control over all your data

premises.text: Developers save months of backend work and pay no data storage costs while scaling on free personal cloud
premises.evidence_span: there are no data storage costs for the developer, and he can scale from one user to millions for free

value.text: Think iCloud for all platforms: easy backend, free to scale, works everywhere
value.evidence_span: Think iCloud, but for all platforms and all devices

causal_links.evidence_span: lack of data continuity across devices

notes: Offline and delete capabilities merged into continuity/control premise.
